880	And so the shed was with Achashverosh, not Queen Esther.	E assim a shed ficou com Achashverosh, e não a rainha Ester.
881	So there's no difficulty at all about how Esther, a married woman, was permitted.	Então não há dificuldade nenhuma sobre como Ester, sendo mulher casada, era permitida.
882	And I say that Sarah our matriarch was no less a mystic than Queen Esther.	E eu digo que Sara, nossa matriarca, não era menos cabalista que a rainha Ester.
883	And if Queen Esther knew how to strip away the shed, and the Zohar also writes	E se a rainha Ester sabia despir a shed, e o Zohar também escreve
884	that Yosef did this with Potiphar's wife, and Sefer Taamei HaMinhagim brings it on page 582,	que Yosef fez isso com a mulher de Potifar, e o livro Taamei HaMinhagim traz isso na página 582,
885	that Yosef would send a shed in his likeness to Potiphar's wife, because she had already driven him mad,	que Yosef enviava uma shed à sua semelhança para a mulher de Potifar, pois ela já o enlouquecera,
886	that one, she'd had enough of the form.	aquela ali, ela já estava farta da aparência.
887	"And she caught him by his garment", by his betrayal.	"E ela o agarrou pela sua veste", pela sua traição.
888	This teaches that she realized he had sent her the shed.	Isso ensina que ela percebeu que ele lhe enviara a shed.
889	She said, I don't want that, I want the real deal.	Ela disse: não quero isso, quero o de verdade.
890	I want the real thing.	Quero a coisa verdadeira.
891	So now, if that's so, then he sent her one, so Esther knows	Então agora, se é assim, ele enviou uma, então Ester sabe
892	how to strip away the shed, Yosef knows how to strip away the shed, so	despir a shed, Yosef sabe despir a shed, então
893	Sarah our matriarch doesn't know how?	Sara, nossa matriarca, não sabe?
894	Rivkah our matriarch doesn't know how? Yes, but they took Sarah, no problem, Sarah goes into the room, tells	Rivká, nossa matriarca, não sabe? Sim, mas levaram Sara, sem problema, Sara entra no quarto, diz
895	him, give me a few minutes to freshen up, goes to the room and sends him the shed,	a ele: dê-me alguns minutos para me arrumar, vai ao quarto e envia a ele a shed,
896	and the shed comes out, yes master, your wish is my command,	e a shed sai: sim, mestre, seu desejo é uma ordem,
897	and she does whatever he wants and the story is over. Amazing, amazing. So according to the secret, no problem, gentlemen.	e ela faz o que ele quer e a história acaba. Incrível, incrível. Então, segundo o segredo, sem problema, senhores.
898	What about Yael?	E Yael?
899	Did Yael also have a shed?	Yael também teve uma shed?
900	Yes.	Sim.
901	The Chida writes in the book Devash LePi, section alef, entry 15.	O Chida escreve no livro Devash LePi, seção alef, verbete 15.
902	Esther was a reincarnation of Yael.	Ester era a reencarnação de Yael.
903	As it says regarding Esther, "Fast".	Como está dito sobre Ester: "Jejuem".
904	"For me" has the letters of Yael: "for me, three days."	"Por mim" tem as letras de Yael: "por mim, três dias."
905	And just as with Esther a shed was provided, with Yael too a shed was provided,	E assim como com Ester houve uma shed, também com Yael houve uma shed,
906	and so there's no difficulty at all.	e assim não há dificuldade nenhuma.
907	According to the Zohar, Tazria 52a, the Zohar writes an answer that is so simple.	Segundo o Zohar, Tazria 52a, o Zohar escreve uma resposta tão simples.
908	When Avraham went down to Egypt, he saw an angel walking in front of Sarah.	Quando Avraham desceu ao Egito, viu um anjo caminhando diante de Sara.
909	Suddenly he sees an angel like that. Wow, okay, a powerful angel.	De repente ele vê um anjo assim. Uau, certo, um anjo poderoso.
910	And he walks in front of Sarah, and Avraham is so spiritual that he manages to see angels, if his maidservant	E ele caminha diante de Sara, e Avraham é tão espiritual que consegue ver anjos, se a serva dele
911	saw angels.	via anjos.
912	"And the angel of HaShem said to her, and the angel of HaShem said to her", for every statement an angel came to her,	"E o anjo de HaShem lhe disse, e o anjo de HaShem lhe disse", a cada fala veio a ela um anjo,
913	Sarah's maidservant sees an angel, Avraham doesn't see angels? Of course he saw angels.	a serva de Sara vê um anjo, Avraham não vê anjos? Claro que via anjos.
914	And the Zohar, Tazria 52a, writes that Avraham sees an angel walking in front of Sarah and says to him, who are you?	E o Zohar, Tazria 52a, escreve que Avraham vê um anjo caminhando diante de Sara e diz a ele: quem és tu?
915	He said to him, hold on, I'm Sarah's bodyguard.	Ele disse: espere, sou o segurança de Sara.
916	He said to him, and what about me?	Avraham disse: e eu?
917	He said to him, I don't know, you figure it out yourself. What about you?	Ele disse: não sei, vire-se sozinho. E você?
918	I'm guarding her.	Eu estou guardando-a.
919	And then Avraham understood that she was guarded.	E então Avraham compreendeu que ela estava protegida.
